stories.title: China-Nepal floods: hundreds of foreigners missing in Tibet after disaster
stories.summary: The Chinese authorities said on Sunday that 261 foreign citizens were missing after last week’s deadly floods along the border between Tibet and Nepal. The Tibetan authorities said that the missing foreigners were from 23 different countries and included 104 Nepalese citizens. They also included 49 from India; 33 Latvians; 18 from the United States; 15 from Britain; six each from Canada and Australia; four from South Africa; three each from Malaysia, Germany and Russia; two from Ireland,...

stories.title: (profile) Macroeconomic expert tapped as new finance minister
stories.summary: Lee Hyoung-il, named new finance minister Sunday, is known as a macroeconomic expert with extensive experience in financial and economic policy. Lee, 55, began his civil service career after passing the national civil service exam in 1992 while studying economics at Seoul National University. He built his expertise in macroeconomics while serving in key posts at the Economic Policy Bureau of the finance ministry. As the first vice finance minister, Lee was in charge of managing and operating the fuel price cap system, which was aimed at stabilizing domestic fuel prices amid supply chain disruptions stemming from the war between the United States and Iran in the Middle East. Lee is regarded by colleagues as a gentle and reasonable official, having been named as a "role model" three times in surveys carried out on finance ministry officials.
